title: Johnathon Pagnutti - Coin Flips, Violence and Spreadsheets: the Binomial Distribution in FE:3Houses
speaker: Johnathon Pagnutti
talk_title: Coin Flips, Violence and Spreadsheets: the Binomial Distribution in FE:3Houses
description: You could go full Dwarf Fortress and simulate everything in your game world, but that's a lot of work. It's a lot easier to just say "60% of the time, it works". However, this simple rule can be surprisingly powerful and dynamic. I'll be doing a lightning tour of some fun tricks (like quantifying luck!) anyone can do with the magic of google sheets given this rule. The violent anime cuties and their random level-ups from Fire Emblem: Three Houses will join us for this tour.
